lang: ca
ref: figura-potencia-antiguitat
format: gfm
execute-dir: project
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
unaltraweb_compute:
  engine: python
  mode: figure
  inputs:
    - context/dades/cartografia_figures.py
    - context/inputs/seccions-tarragones.geojson
    - context/inputs/seccions-resultats.json
  outputs:
    - assets/img/generated/potencia-antiguitat.svg
---

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root = Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root == root.parent: raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root = root.parent
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('maps', root/'context/dades/cartografia_figures.py')
maps = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(maps)
features, result = maps.load(root)
rows = [f['properties'] for f in features if f['properties']['association_sample']]
x = np.array([r['age_median_exact'] for r in rows])
y = np.log1p([r['kw_per_100_buildings'] for r in rows])
b, a = np.polyfit(x, y, 1); residuals = y - (a+b*x)
assert len(x) == 126 and np.isclose(np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1], result['association']['pearson_r'])
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.1, 4.5), layout='constrained')
axes[0].scatter(x, y, s=27, color='#326b94', alpha=.65)
grid = np.linspace(x.min(), x.max(), 100)
axes[0].plot(grid, a+b*grid, color='#bd3644', lw=2)
axes[0].set(title='A · Associació entre seccions', xlabel='Antiguitat mediana (anys)',
            ylabel='log(1 + kW per 100 edificis)')
axes[0].text(.97,.97,'n = 126\nr = −0,401\nR² = 0,161', transform=axes[0].transAxes,
             ha='right', va='top', bbox={'facecolor':'white','edgecolor':'none','alpha':.9})
axes[1].scatter(a+b*x, residuals, s=27, color='#326b94', alpha=.65)
axes[1].axhline(0, color='#bd3644', lw=1.5)
axes[1].set(title='B · Residus del mateix ajust', xlabel='Valor ajustat, escala logarítmica',
            ylabel='Observat − ajustat')
for ax in axes:
    ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
    ax.grid(alpha=.12)
maps.save(fig, root, 'potencia-antiguitat')
```
